svg.title: The same coordinates, a different domain
svg.desc: A pale blue disk and a gently asymmetric green convex domain have matching radial grids. Copper points lie at the same fraction of corresponding rays, linked by the map Phi.
svg.metadata: Conceptual cover. Phi(r u)=r R(u)u, Phi(0)=0. The disk maps bijectively to a smooth convex domain containing the origin. Its support function h(a)=1+0.12 cos(2a)+0.04 sin(3a) satisfies h+h''>=0.32; its boundary is h n+h' t. R(u) is the unique positive ray-boundary intersection. The map preserves a radial fraction, not area or probability density.
